goal:
T70 — signed Arena results (so a published comparison, e.g. in the demo video, can be checked offline). Reuse
services/api/evoforge/proof.py (Ed25519 with EVO_PROOF_SIGNING_KEY; same canonical signing and proof.verify).
- GET /v1/arena/{id}/proof: unknown -> 404; not finished (status not succeeded/failed) -> 409. The first call mints
  and stores ONE certificate; later calls return the stored one (same certificate_id and signature), with the usual
  "verify" envelope ({...cert, "verify": proof.verify(cert)}). It is also served by GET /v1/proof/cert/{certificate_id}
  (store it under the same certificate key namespace main.py uses for evidence certificates).
- Certificate body (signed fields): certificate_id, kind "arena", arena_id, issued_at, mode ("sealed" or "prompt"),
  round_index and root_id when present, verdict (the winner string: evoforge|single|tie|unscorable), model,
  manifest: the arena's manifest hash/count/allowance fields (task_spec_hash, heldout_hash, base_tree_sha,
  prompt_hash, acceptance_hash, acceptance_count, comparison_mode, cost_basis, lanes allowances — whichever exist),
  lanes: {single|evoforge: {status, outcome, heldout {passed, n}, cost_cents, attempts, diff_sha256 (sha256 hex of the
  lane's final diff, "" when none), preview_sha256 (sha256 hex of preview_html, "" when none)}}. Never include code,
  diffs, preview HTML, held-out or judge tests. Unsigned (no key) -> the honest unsigned form proof.mint uses.
  Add a proof.mint_arena(arena_doc) helper next to mint().
- Proxy: allow GET /v1/arena/<id>/proof (proxyPolicy.ts + proxyPolicy.cases.json).
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t70.py.
